title: Data and code for: Sigmoid allometries generate male dimorphism in secondary sexual traits - a comment on Packard (2023)
description:
Simulation code, stored simulation output and empirical harvestmen datasets used to test whether bimodality in secondary sexual traits can be generated by sigmoid static allometries alone. Contains the simulation routines, the helper functions for fitting allometries and detecting dimorphism, and the five empirical body-size/weapon-size datasets re-analysed in the comment.

Supplement to: Sigmoid allometries generate male dimorphism in secondary sexual traits: a comment on Packard (2023). Evolutionary Ecology 38(4): 537–548. doi:10.1007/s10682-024-10303-6
